title: Change image actor via set move route buggy(?)

posts.author: rondchild
posts.body:
Hello there!
So, I try to change my image actore via set move route and after my actor get transfer map to other map.
My actor change the image to default image...Is this intended as rmmz feature or it should be not?
Because As I remember when in the previous version is not work like this.

posts.author: Canned_Dinosaur
posts.body:
Unsure if it is default behavior (I think it is), but it works the same way in my projects (but this may be due to Events and Movement Core VisuStella MZ). In any case, if you wan the actor image to be permanent, you can just use the
Change Actor Images Event Command
instead.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
rondchild said:
Because As I remember when in the previous version is not work like this.
Click to expand...
I don't know whether you mean "previous version" as an older version of RPG Maker or an older version of MZ.
Both MV and MZ work exactly like this, the correct way to change the actor's image is with the event command. I haven't done or tested it in VX Ace or older.
